Anika is a hyaluronic-acid-based medical device / combination-product company; assets pursued through FDA PMA (device) and NDA (Cingal combination).

website.notes: /pipeline subpage returns 404. Homepage lists commercial products (Integrity, Hyalofast outside US, Tactoset, NanoFx, Cingal outside US, Monovisc, Orthovisc) but does not enumerate ongoing trials.

ctgov.notes: All four kept ClinicalTrials.gov records are Phase 3 Cingal studies, all marked COMPLETED (latest primary completion 2022-05). The active US Cingal bioequivalence study and the Hyalofast US FastTRACK Phase III are sourced from the 10-K and corporate disclosures (Hyalofast PMA submitted 2025-10-31; bioequivalence study initiated December 2025).

pipeline.modality: Hyaluronic acid (HA) resorbable scaffold (Class III medical device); single-stage off-the-shelf cartilage repair, used with autologous bone marrow aspirate concentrate (BMAC)

indications.highest_phase: P3 (US pivotal IDE study completed; PMA filed - under FDA review)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, controlled, multicenter pivotal IDE study comparing Hyalofast plus BMAC vs microfracture in approximately 200 patients with knee cartilage defects; two-year follow-up; co-primary endpoints: pain (KOOS Pain) and function (KOOS ADL).
indications.trial_status: Enrollment completed May 2023; topline results July 2025 (co-primary endpoints not met; statistically significant improvements on KOOS Sports & Recreation, Quality of Life, Total KOOS). Modular PMA submitted; final (third) PMA module filed 2025-10-31. FDA deficiency letter received January 2026; Anika preparing response with resubmission expected in coming months.
key_milestones: 2026-Q1 FDA deficiency letter received (CMC + statistical analysis plan)

pipeline.modality: Combination product (drug-device): proprietary cross-linked hyaluronic acid + triamcinolone hexacetonide (fast-acting steroid), single intra-articular injection; regulated as an NDA in the US

indications.indication: Osteoarthritis knee pain - US regulatory pathway (commercial outside the US in 50+ countries under CE mark)
indications.highest_phase: P3 (three Phase 3 efficacy studies complete; active pivotal bioequivalence study and preclinical work supporting US NDA submission)
indications.trial_design: Bioequivalence study of Cingal vs reference triamcinolone hexacetonide drug (Aristospan) to address final FDA NDA requirements; preclinical / toxicity studies completed 2025.
indications.trial_status: Bioequivalence study INITIATED December 2025 (per company disclosures). Earlier Phase 3 efficacy program (NCT04231318, NCT03390036, NCT03191903, NCT02381652) all COMPLETED; third pivotal Phase 3 (NCT04231318) achieved primary endpoint in 2022.
key_milestones: 2022 third pivotal Phase 3 met primary endpoint
2024-09 Anika acquired Aristospan NDA (reference drug source); 2025-04 sold to third-party manufacturer
Targeting US NDA submission contingent on bioequivalence enrollment
